title: FUEL criteria preregistration v1 (fuel_trajectory single-verdict standard)
applies_to: v5-delivered fuel_trajectory batches (selfline production / question-bank r78+) and batches where v5 acts as evaluator

evaluator_policy.empirical_basis: r79 split-verdict case: prime 0.75/0.92 series vs kairos 0.25/0.3 series untranslatable (compass #3007 ruling 2)

verdict.machine_rule: convert_submit deterministic check, never LLM self-report

fail.notes: fail is a legal delivery (GRPO needs negatives); strictly distinct from pseudo-fail (see errata_binding)

insufficient_evidence.settlement: excluded: U state, not positive, not negative; insufficient evidence is not failure

zero_variance_flag.trigger: same evaluator, same batch, >= 8 identical values (r79 case: 8 x 0.75)
zero_variance_flag.action: flag whole group U, suspect formula score

precondition_gates.semantics: any gate failing => batch does not enter judging, verdict = U

gates.rule: trajectory JSON is the only valid delivery form
gates.notes: result text reports (incl. self-reported 'scored(0.55)' style) do not constitute delivery

gates.rule: claim_subject == trajectory.source.operator AND trajectory asset replayable
gates.asset_replay_check: cross-check fuel_trajectories table or staging files by qid
gates.asset_path_null_is: normal for registration-flow (not a red flag)
gates.quick_claim_submit_is: legal registration action (trajectory-first, register-then-backfill pipeline form)
gates.before_anomaly_filing_must: triangulate own production traces: run log + staging + workdirs timestamps
gates.basis: r79 misdiagnosis case 2026-10-04 (quick-submit was misread as impersonation, retracted same day)

gates.rule: transcript contains real tool_call turns (not pure-text replies)

required_all: prompt_hash_dedup_counted (duplicate pairs forbidden in training pool)

audit_sampling.method: manual review: transcript actuality vs verdict consistency
audit_sampling.on_mismatch: flag whole batch U + errata registration

errata_binding.new_verdict: nullable; gap report is not overturn, rework suggestion only
errata_binding.judge_self_label: forbidden forever (exception: self-admit, honest failure registration; ref f012 forfeiture case)

pseudo_fail.definition: delivery actually passes but was judged fail (e.g. f067/f075/d65ef94b prompt-bias cases)
pseudo_fail.policy: isolated, not counted as negative sample

code_binding.amendment_rule: changing code requires amending this file to v2 first

immutability.amendment: v2 with new version + date + reason; applies to future batches only
